END-TO-END ENTERPRISE AGENT ENGINEERING & WORKFLOW AUTOMATION PIPELINE (L1 ➔ L4)
1. Unified CLI & MCP Profile Sync (cc-switch ★156.8k): Distribute approved provider keys, MCP configs & prompts across 12+ coding CLIs in one click.
2. Persistent Code + Infra Graph (codebase-memory-mcp ★49.1k): Map cross-repo code, docs & Terraform/K8s topology locally in C before editing.
3. Symbol-Precision Refactoring (serena ★31.6k): Use LSP-backed `find_symbol` and `replace_symbol_body` instead of error-prone full-file rewrites.
4. Enterprise iPaaS Orchestration (n8n-mcp ★23.3k): Author, schema-validate & debug production n8n automation pipelines directly from the IDE.
